description: A button putting out 10V while it is pressed and 0V the rest of the time, with a text area for writing down what it is patched to

params.text: Puts out 10V for as long as it is held down

outputs.text: Carries 10V while the button is held and 0V otherwise

notes: the dark area on the panel takes typed text, for labelling what the button controls; the text is saved with the patch
shift-dragging up or down on the module name changes the colour of the panel, and holding ctrl as well makes the change finer
